name: persona-claude
description: Claude Code plugin that routes mutable Bash work through persona session patches.

PERSONA_BIN.description: Command name or path for the persona binary (for example persona or /abs/path/to/persona).

DAEMON_BASE_MODE.description: Optional daemon base mode override for wrapped sessions (worktree by default; repo only when explicitly selected).

DAEMON_BASE_REF.description: Optional daemon base ref override when using worktree mode.

DAEMON_ALLOW_DIRTY.description: Optional boolean override for daemon allow-dirty behavior.

DAEMON_IGNORED_MODE.description: Optional daemon ignored mode override (transparent, readonly, or masked).

DAEMON_IGNORED_MAX.description: Optional daemon ignored-max override for wrapped sessions.

DAEMON_APPLY_MODE.description: Optional daemon apply mode override (strict or reject).

FLUSH_MIN_AGE.description: Legacy daemon flush option; file-tool leases always flush durably on release and do not skip saving.

FLUSH_RETRY_FOR.description: Legacy daemon flush retry option; file-tool leases now release and flush atomically.

FLUSH_RETRY_INTERVAL_MS.description: Legacy daemon flush retry option; file-tool leases now release and flush atomically.
